info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Aspen Pendant Detail-v1-spec
info.description: The Aspen Pendant Detail Management API facilitates the creation and management of detailed information related to Aspen pendants in the catalog. This endpoint allows users to submit detailed specifications, pricing, and attributes for new pendant listings. It is designed for retailers and catalog managers looking to enhance their product offerings with rich, accurate data. By utilizing this API, consumers can streamline their catalog updates and ensure that product details are consistently maintained across their platforms.

post.summary: Create details for the Aspen pendant.
post.description: This endpoint allows users to submit detailed information about the Aspen pendant, facilitating better management and representation of its specifications and features.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to provide the details for creating or updating an Aspen pendant entry. Ensure that all required fields are provided according to the specified schema.
